game_title: C Archive · Ritchie and Bell Labs
game_concept: A action defense set in Shadow Cave – Exit Light Ledge, a ledge toward daylight: the spelunker must handle cave spiders while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Doubling Growth: Double a size each pass with while size < goal to grow the stone seal fast.
theme: Shadow Cave – Exit Light Ledge: a ledge toward daylight
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Archive variation 2: classify and verify C history, characteristics and language categories for Ritchie and Bell Labs.
controls: Read each archive record and choose the supported C fact.
win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: size drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 33-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: CP1 Week 4: Ritchie and Bell Labs
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
